note: Rewritten from the 'Diagnostic character' section and table 57 of Maiti, A taxonomic monograph on the world species of termites (Memoirs of the Zoological Survey of India, vol. 20, no. 4; archive.org identifier dli.zoological.memoirs.020.04); the original is in English; a concise diagnostic account at genus level. The original records the major soldier as unknown, which is not supplemented; only dealate alates were available and the 'length with wings' column for this species is empty in table 57, so only the length without wings is given.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Alate (dealate individual) distinguished from all Australian species of the genus by the anterior part of the postclypeus narrowed, nose-shaped and overhanging the base of the labrum; compound eyes small and markedly protruding, suboval, ocelli small, distinct, clearly separated from the compound eyes; frons strongly arched with a deep groove, vertex and frons distinctly wrinkled. Major soldier unknown; minor soldier with the head short and wide, widest at the middle, distinctly narrowed behind the antennal insertions, posterior margin rounded with several hairs; labrum long with a median longitudinal groove, apical margin bilobed with a fringe of fine hairs, the labrum projecting beyond the tips of the mandibles.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head yellowish brown, postclypeus and mandibles dark brown, wing buds (the stubs remaining after dealation) dark brown. Anterior part of the postclypeus narrowed, nose-shaped, overhanging the base of the labrum. Compound eyes small, suboval, markedly protruding; ocelli small, distinct, clearly separated from the compound eyes. Frons strongly arched with a deep groove, vertex and frons distinctly wrinkled. Thorax and abdomen with sparse long hairs. Measurements (mm): body length without wings 7.00—7.50; maximum head width (including compound eyes) 1.61—1.67; maximum diameter of the compound eye (including the eye plate) 0.39—0.42; maximum diameter of the lateral ocellus 0.12; maximum length of the pronotum 0.73—0.77, maximum width 1.20—1.32.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Major soldier: recorded as 'Unknown' in the original, unknown. Minor soldier: body rather small. Head short and wide, widest at the middle, distinctly narrowed behind the antennal insertions, posterior margin rounded with several hairs. Labrum long, with a median longitudinal groove, apical margin divided into two lobes, the margins of the lobes with a fringe of fine hairs, the labrum projecting beyond the tips of the mandibles. Mandibles long and slender, pointed apically, left mandible with 2 and right mandible with 1 marginal teeth. Antennae 12—13-segmented, usually 13, segment 3 smallest. Pronotum small, anterior margin produced forwards in the middle, posterior margin with a median notch.
